title: blur_gate.py out-of-frame sample raises uncaught exception; setup error exits as 'gate red'
evidence:
for name, tx, ty in SPAWNS:
        x, y = node_screen(tx, ty)
        r, g, b = blurred.getpixel((int(round(x)), int(round(y))))
...
Exit code 0 = gate green, 1 = gate red, 2 = usage/setup error.
detail: A wrong-size image or a changed view fit puts samples off-frame; getpixel raises, Python exits 1 — indistinguishable from a measured gate failure despite the documented exit-2 contract.
recommended_fix: Wrap sampling in try/except printing a setup error with sys.exit(2); assert img.size == (1280, 720) before sampling.

title: --sigma/--out with a missing value are silently ignored, gate runs at defaults
detail: A trailing flag without a value fails the length guard and is dropped without complaint; the gate then measures sigma 6 while the operator believes otherwise. Unknown args are also accepted silently.
recommended_fix: Error with exit 2 when a flag lacks a value or an unknown argument appears.

title: draw_type_chip lacks the fam.a==0 guard its sibling washes have — role .None draws an empty chip
detail: Terminal_Role includes .None; terminal_family returns alpha-0 for it. draw_family_wash skips, but draw_type_chip has no such guard — a role-less terminal still gets a paper chip with no glyph.
recommended_fix: Gate the chip on fam.a != 0 alongside chip_visible, or validate role before drawing.
